mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals imminent monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline fails to produce positive 20-day returns in > 50% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 305.0 indicates persistent inflation, triggering expectations of prolonged Fed tightening that compresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of CPIAUCSL > 305.0 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint HOUST and RSAFS growth fails to produce positive 20-day returns in > 50% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the regime of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and strong job growth (PAYEMS MoM growth > 0.5%), labor market tightness fuels consumer spending and corporate profitability, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: low unemployment and strong job growth
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of trigger periods, or joint condition Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects expanding manufacturing output and supply chain resilience, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO trend shows no correlation with 60-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year window, or positive returns occur in < 40% of rising INDPRO instances.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST falling below 1250.0 thousand units signals weakening residential construction, triggering concerns about economic slowdown and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1250.0 fails to predict negative 5-day returns in > 50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the regime of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 305.0) and elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), aggressive Fed tightening suppresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: high inflation and high interest rates
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of trigger periods, or joint condition Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates tightening labor market conditions, which typically precedes stronger consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE decline shows no correlation with 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year window, or positive returns occur in < 40% of declining UNRATE instances.
